snippet.title: HuzzyGames
snippet.description:
I'm a British gamer who right now specialises in League of Legends. I try and help you become a better player - mechanically and mentally. My main account in League is in Master on EUW. I currently main Mid / Jungle / Top.

My Summoner names in League generally have something to do with the Huzzy name, if they don't & someone is claiming to be, it's not me. Active accounts right now; Only server I generally play on is EUW - Huzzy, HuzzLightyear, HuzzyGames, ImNotHuzzy, HuzzLightyear, HuzzinAintEasy & Huzzy (On NA Server).

PC Specs (Main Components): 
GPU: MSI GeForce RTX 2080Ti 11GB
CPU: Intel i9-9900k
Memory: 32GB (4x8GB) DDR4/3000mhz Corsair
Motherboard: MSI Z370 Gaming Pro Carbon
PSU: Corsair RM850x 80+ Gold
Storage: 250GB M.2, x2 500GB SSD, x1 2TB HDD

Business Email is used for sponsorship / collaboration requests. Please do not send MCN offers as I am in a lock in contract. Music "labels" will be instantly blocked.
